assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and lightheadedness in the setting of known sick sinus syndrome and a personal history of transient ischemic attack and cerebral infarction
warranting correlation of these symptomatic events with underlying arrhythmias via mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring (CPT 93229)
This service was denied under CO-22
indicating coverage may be available through another insurer pursuant to coordination of benefits protocols
with the primary carrier to be satisfied prior to further review
The service is medically necessary to optimize rate control management for this patient's clinical presentation
